name: nylon_guitar
description: Jewelbox 17 Acoustic Guitar Nylon (classical): three clear-white nylon trebles and three silver-wound basses (the striker) over a pale spruce classical body face-on - wide figure-of-eight outline with rosewood binding, green/gold mosaic rosette, tie-block bridge - cedar neck and a slotted headstock with white rollers and side tuners (adapted from guitar v5, which keeps the steel-string sunburst).
